scope: Local real uvicorn/uvloop/Pi with synthetic 60-second model await; main-only SIGTERM; not a real systemd TimeoutStopSec=45 proof

first_attempt.limitation: Harness exited on missing marker; detailed timing and child state not retained.

confirmed: Server exited 30.159 seconds after main-only SIGTERM with graceful timeout 30 seconds.
Client received RemoteDisconnected, never a successful completion.
No provider calls or model retries occurred.
unproven: The request cancellation handler did not run before server exit.
Pi async context cleanup and awaited child reap were not observed.
Immediate child existence check still saw the child; later process inspection found no live Pi, which does not prove awaited reap.

configuration_note: Minimal ASGI app used lifespan=off; this does not reproduce production lifespan teardown.
mechanism: uvicorn 0.32.0 shutdown cancels outstanding tasks without awaiting them; capture_signals then replays SIGTERM. This can end the main process before asynchronous request cleanup is scheduled.
release_boundary: Bounded main exit and non-success are evidenced; guaranteed child cleanup remains a systemd cgroup final-kill boundary. Do not disable SendSIGKILL/FinalKillSignal or infer successful draining.
